movie_title: Sleepy in South Korea - 6 Minute English
introduction:
Improve your English vocabulary and listening in just six mintues!
How many hours do you sleep? Not

vocabulary.definition: a short sleep, especially during the day
vocabulary.example: After lunch, I like to take a quick nap to recharge.

vocabulary.definition: feeling worried or upset, especially because you cannot relax
vocabulary.example: She became agitated when she couldn't find her keys.

vocabulary.definition: gradually take over someone's time, rights, or personal space
vocabulary.example: The new project encroached on his weekend plans.

vocabulary.definition: unpleasant and unexpected results caused by a drug or treatment
vocabulary.example: The medication has some side-effects like dizziness and nausea.

vocabulary.definition: a condition where you have difficulty falling asleep or staying asleep
vocabulary.example: Her anxiety often leads to episodes of insomnia.

vocabulary.definition: the practice of focusing your mind on a particular object, thought, or activity to train attention and awareness
vocabulary.example: She finds peace through daily meditation and mindfulness.
